facts.value: Defines the Gr_Kind_TSeak ground-stage controller: binds /GrTSk.dat and three ground-object callback records into StageData, initializes objects through the common Target Test path, and starts the shared Zako/generated-item manager with a NULL spawn descriptor. The start hook does not directly construct target objects.
facts.rationale: Replaces misleading target-generator terminology with the operation demonstrated by the callee.

facts.value: Initialization requests ground objects 0, 1 and 2 through the common Target Test helper. Each successful retrieval receives rendering, callback3, initialization and process setup; null retrieval reports a diagnostic and returns NULL. The setup helper does not consume callback1 or table flags. Start attempts shared Zako/generated-item manager creation with NULL and ignores success or failure. Object callbacks provide animation/joint setup and delegated processing alongside empty handlers and stored constant-false predicates. Touch-line lookup returns NULL and the shadow predicate always returns true.
facts.rationale: Preserves local behavior and exceptional branches while correcting manager terminology and separating stored predicates from installed callbacks.
